time = data[:, 0]  # time in ps
msd = data[:, 1]   # MSD in A^2

print(f"Time range: {time[0]:.2f} to {time[-1]:.2f} ps")
print(f"MSD range: {msd[0]:.2f} to {msd[-1]:.2f} A^2")
print(f"Total data points: {len(time)}")

# For the linear region, use from 100 ps onwards to capture diffusive regime
# Avoid initial ballistic regime
start_time = 100.0  # ps
start_idx = np.argmin(np.abs(time - start_time))

time_fit = time[start_idx:]
msd_fit = msd[start_idx:]

print(f"\nFitting from {time_fit[0]:.2f} ps to {time_fit[-1]:.2f} ps")
print(f"Number of points in fit: {len(time_fit)}")

# Linear fit: MSD = 6*D*t (for 3D diffusion)
# Force through origin for better physics
# Using polyfit with degree 1
coeffs = np.polyfit(time_fit, msd_fit, 1)
slope = coeffs[0]  # A^2/ps
intercept = coeffs[1]

print(f"\nLinear fit results:")
print(f"  Slope: {slope:.6f} A^2/ps")
print(f"  Intercept: {intercept:.6f} A^2")

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
# MSD = 6*D*t => D = slope/6
D_A2_ps = slope / 6.0  # A^2/ps

# Convert to m^2/s

"""

D = MSD / (6 * t)
where MSD is in Angstrom^2 and t is in picoseconds

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

msd_total = data[:, 4]  # Total MSD in Angstrom^2

# Skip initial part to avoid transient effects

start_idx = len(time) // 2
time_fit = time[start_idx:]
msd_fit = msd_total[start_idx:]

# Linear fit: MSD = 6*D*t
# Slope = 6*D
coeffs = np.polyfit(time_fit, msd_fit, 1)
slope = coeffs[0]  # Angstrom^2/ps

# Calculate diffusion coefficient

"""
Analyze MSD data and calculate diffusion coefficient using Einstein relation.
D = MSD / (6*t)
Units: metal (Angstrom^2/ps) -> convert to m^2/s
"""

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('msd.dat', comments='#')
time_steps = data[:, 0]  # timesteps
msd_total = data[:, 4]   # total MSD in Angstrom^2

# Convert timesteps to time (ps)
# timestep = 0.001 ps
dt = 0.001  # ps
time_ps = time_steps * dt

# Use linear region for fitting (skip initial non-linear region)
# Typically use the later portion of the data
start_idx = len(time_ps) // 4  # Start from 25% of data
end_idx = len(time_ps)

time_fit = time_ps[start_idx:end_idx]
msd_fit = msd_total[start_idx:end_idx]

# Linear fit: MSD = 6*D*t
# D = slope / 6
coeffs = np.polyfit(time_fit, msd_fit, 1)
slope = coeffs[0]  # Angstrom^2/ps

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
D_angstrom_ps = slope / 6.0  # Angstrom^2/ps

print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_m2_s:.6e} m^2/s")

plt.xlabel('Time (ps)')
plt.ylabel('MSD (Angstrom^2)')
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time')
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Calculate self-diffusion coefficient from MSD data using Einstein relation.
D = MSD / (6*t) for 3D diffusion
"""

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('msd.dat', comments='#')
steps = data[:, 0]
msd = data[:, 1]  # MSD in Angstrom^2

# Convert step to time in ps (timestep = 0.001 ps = 1 fs)
timestep = 0.001  # ps
time = steps * timestep  # time in ps

# Skip initial transient and use linear regime for fitting
# Use data from 20% to 80% of the production run
n_points = len(time)
start_idx = int(0.2 * n_points)
end_idx = int(0.8 * n_points)

time_fit = time[start_idx:end_idx]
msd_fit = msd[start_idx:end_idx]

# Linear fit: MSD = 6*D*t
# Slope = 6*D in Angstrom^2/ps
coeffs = np.polyfit(time_fit, msd_fit, 1)
slope = coeffs[0]  # Angstrom^2/ps

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
# D = slope / 6
D_A2_ps = slope / 6.0  # Angstrom^2/ps

# Convert to m^2/s
# 1 Angstrom = 1e-10 m
# 1 ps = 1e-12 s
# D [m^2/s] = D [Angstrom^2/ps] * (1e-10)^2 / (1e-12)
# D [m^2/s] = D [Angstrom^2/ps] * 1e-8
D_m2_s = D_A2_ps * 1e-8

print(f"Linear fit results:")
print(f"  Slope: {slope:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"  Intercept: {coeffs[1]:.6e} Angstrom^2")
print(f"\nDiffusion coefficient:")
print(f"  D = {D_A2_ps:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"  D = {D_m2_s:.6e} m^2/s")

# Calculate R^2 to check quality of fit
msd_fit_predicted = np.polyval(coeffs, time_fit)
ss_res = np.sum((msd_fit - msd_fit_predicted)**2)
ss_tot = np.sum((msd_fit - np.mean(msd_fit))**2)
r_squared = 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot)
print(f"  R^2 = {r_squared:.6f}")

# Save result to file
with open('diffusion_coefficient.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"Self-diffusion coefficient of liquid silicon at 2500K\n")
    f.write(f"=====================================================\n")
    f.write(f"D = {D_m2_s:.6e} m^2/s\n")
    f.write(f"D = {D_A2_ps:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps\n")
    f.write(f"\nFit quality: R^2 = {r_squared:.6f}\n")
    f.write(f"Slope: {slope:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps\n")
    f.write(f"Time range used: {time_fit[0]:.2f} - {time_fit[-1]:.2f} ps\n")

# Create plot

plt.plot(time, msd, 'b-', linewidth=1, label='MSD data')
plt.plot(time_fit, msd_fit_predicted, 'r--', linewidth=2, 
         label=f'Linear fit (R²={r_squared:.4f})\nD={D_m2_s:.3e} m²/s')
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('MSD (Angstrom²)', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time\nLiquid Silicon at 2500K', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(fontsize=10)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('msd_plot.png', dpi=300)
print(f"\nPlot saved as msd_plot.png")

# Print final result in requested format
print(f"\n{'='*60}")
print(f"FINAL ANSWER: {D_m2_s:.6e}")
print(f"{'='*60}")

atom_style      full
boundary        p p p

replicate       3 3 3

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Calculate diffusion coefficient from MSD data using Einstein relation.
D = MSD / (6*t) for 3D diffusion
"""

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('msd_data.txt', comments='#')
steps = data[:, 0]
msd_total = data[:, 4]  # Total MSD in Angstrom^2

# Convert timestep to time in ps (timestep = 0.001 ps = 1 fs)
time_ps = steps * 0.001

# Einstein relation: MSD = 6*D*t
# D = MSD / (6*t)
# We'll fit the linear region of MSD vs time

# Skip initial transient (first 10% of data)
skip = len(time_ps) // 10
time_fit = time_ps[skip:]
msd_fit = msd_total[skip:]

# Linear fit: MSD = slope * t + intercept
# slope = 6*D
coeffs = np.polyfit(time_fit, msd_fit, 1)
slope = coeffs[0]  # Angstrom^2 / ps
intercept = coeffs[1]

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
# D in Angstrom^2/ps
D_A2_ps = slope / 6.0

# Convert to m^2/s
# 1 Angstrom = 1e-10 m
# 1 ps = 1e-12 s
# So 1 Angstrom^2/ps = (1e-10)^2 / 1e-12 m^2/s = 1e-8 m^2/s
D_m2_s = D_A2_ps * 1e-8

print(f"MSD data points: {len(steps)}")
print(f"Time range: {time_ps[0]:.2f} to {time_ps[-1]:.2f} ps")
print(f"MSD range: {msd_total[0]:.2f} to {msd_total[-1]:.2f} Angstrom^2")
print(f"\nLinear fit (using last 90% of data):")
print(f"  Slope: {slope:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"  Intercept: {intercept:.6f} Angstrom^2")
print(f"\nDiffusion coefficient:")
print(f"  D = {D_A2_ps:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"  D = {D_m2_s:.6e} m^2/s")
print(f"\nFinal Answer: {D_m2_s:.2e}")

# Create plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time_ps, msd_total, 'b-', linewidth=1, label='MSD data')
plt.plot(time_fit, slope * time_fit + intercept, 'r--', linewidth=2, 
         label=f'Linear fit (slope={slope:.4f} Å²/ps)')
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('MSD (Angstrom²)', fontsize=12)
plt.title(f'Mean Squared Displacement at 2500K\nD = {D_m2_s:.2e} m²/s', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(fontsize=10)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('msd_plot.png', dpi=150)
print("\nPlot saved as msd_plot.png")

# Save results to file
with open('diffusion_result.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient of liquid silicon at 2500K\n")
    f.write(f"=" * 50 + "\n\n")
    f.write(f"D = {D_m2_s:.6e} m^2/s\n")
    f.write(f"D = {D_A2_ps:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps\n\n")
    f.write(f"Linear fit parameters:\n")
    f.write(f"  Slope: {slope:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps\n")
    f.write(f"  Intercept: {intercept:.6f} Angstrom^2\n")
    f.write(f"\nData range: {time_ps[0]:.2f} - {time_ps[-1]:.2f} ps\n")
    f.write(f"Fit range: {time_fit[0]:.2f} - {time_fit[-1]:.2f} ps\n")

print("Results saved to diffusion_result.txt")

# LAMMPS input script for silicon melting simulation
# Units: metal (eV, Angstrom, ps, K)

# Initialization
units           metal
atom_style      full
boundary        p p p

# Read structure and replicate
read_data       silicon.data
replicate       3 3 3

# Potential setup (Stillinger-Weber)
pair_style      sw
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

# Neighbor settings
neighbor        2.0 bin
neigh_modify    every 1 delay 0 check yes

# Timestep
timestep        0.001  # 1 fs

# Compute MSD for diffusion coefficient calculation
compute         msd all msd com yes

# Thermodynamic output
thermo_style    custom step temp press density pe ke etotal c_msd[4]
thermo          1000

# Phase 1: Heating from 300K to 2500K at 2.2 K/ps
# Temperature change = 2200 K
# Rate = 2.2 K/ps
# Time needed = 2200 / 2.2 = 1000 ps = 1000000 fs = 1000000 steps
velocity        all create 300.0 12345 dist gaussian
fix             1 all npt temp 300.0 2500.0 $(100.0*dt) iso 0.0 0.0 $(1000.0*dt)
run             1000000
unfix           1

# Phase 2: Equilibration at 2500K for 500 ps (500000 steps)
fix             2 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 $(100.0*dt) iso 0.0 0.0 $(1000.0*dt)
run             500000
unfix           2

# Phase 3: Production run for MSD calculation
# Reset MSD compute
uncompute       msd
compute         msd all msd com yes

# Continue NPT at 2500K for another 500 ps to collect MSD data
fix             3 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 $(100.0*dt) iso 0.0 0.0 $(1000.0*dt)

# Output MSD data to file
fix             msd_output all print 100 "$(step) $(c_msd[4])" file msd_data.txt screen no title "# Step MSD"

run             500000
unfix           3
unfix           msd_output

print           "Simulation completed successfully"

units           metal
atom_style      full
boundary        p p p

read_data       silicon.data
replicate       3 3 3

# Define potential - Stillinger-Weber for Si
pair_style      sw
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

# Neighbor settings
neighbor        2.0 bin
neigh_modify    every 1 delay 0 check yes

# Thermodynamic output settings
thermo          1000
thermo_style    custom step temp press density pe ke etotal vol

timestep        0.001  # 1 fs

# ========================================

# ========================================
velocity        all create 300.0 12345 dist gaussian
fix             1 all npt temp 300.0 300.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0

unfix           1
